cards.title: Nvidia Board Investigates CEO Jensen Huang
cards.body: Nvidia's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang over his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. Yale professor Jeffrey Sonnenfeld estimates there's roughly a 50-50 chance Huang remains as CEO.

cards.title: Huang Admits Affair in Company Memo
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair in a memo to the company. The disclosure comes as the board investigates his relationship with a possible Chinese spy.

cards.title: Midterms Shake Up Tech Industry
cards.body: Democrats' historic midterm victories could reshape the AI and tech industries. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures with majority support for restrictions.

cards.title: China Allegedly Recruited Spy on Nvidia
cards.body: A US intelligence memo claims China's Ministry of State Security recruited a female tech executive to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The memo was circulated earlier this year.

cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center to Google
cards.body: Crusoe Energy sold its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google. The deal underscores the significant challenges in developing massive AI infrastructure.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $11B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI reportedly raised an additional $11 billion in funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation. The funding round is expected to close in the coming weeks.

cards.title: Artex AI Hacking Tools Publicly Exposed
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting Artex penetration testing tools exposed to the internet. Anyone could access the hacking tool without authorization.

cards.title: Meta Launches Spaces for Muse Agents
cards.body: Meta introduced Spaces as a new collaboration feature for its Muse AI agents. The platform offers fresh ways to interact with AI helpers.

cards.title: Data Center Restrictions Win at Ballot
cards.body: Voters approved restrictions on data center development in 40 of 41 ballot measures on Tuesday. Democrats' midterm victories could reshape AI industry expansion plans.

cards.title: AI Industry Faces Rough Two Years Ahead
cards.body: Democrats' historic midterm victories could transform the tech industry fundamentally. Public opposition to data centers threatens AI expansion across multiple regions.

cards.title: AI Spending Stalls Despite Usage Growth
cards.body: Ramp data shows AI spending has stalled even as usage continues climbing. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among big spenders challenge hypergrowth assumptions.

cards.title: Amazon Enables Text-Based Alexa Shopping
cards.body: Amazon launched text-to-Alexa shopping features after initially blocking Muse integration. The feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

cards.title: Underdog Demos 32MB Speech Model
cards.body: Underdog showcased a remarkably compact 32MB model capable of generating speech and music. The small size demonstrates significant progress in efficient AI model development.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M for Robot Simulation
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to bridge the sim-to-real gap for robotics applications. The company uses a pipeline originally built for online retail.

cards.title: Palo Alto Networks Buys Clutch for $500M
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for $500 million. Clutch was previously valued at $85 million.

cards.title: Airbnb Launches AI Travel Agent in 2027
cards.body: Airbnb announced plans to launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. The agent will help users plan trips, compare options, and manage bookings.

cards.title: Meta's Muse AI Gets Video Avatar Feature
cards.body: Meta's Muse AI agent can now take video calls as a customizable animated avatar. The feature previews upcoming Tamagotchi-like wearable hardware.

cards.title: Meta Warns of Data Center Expansion Risks
cards.body: Meta warned that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments. Communities are increasingly pushing back against massive infrastructure projects.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases New Cybersecurity Model
cards.body: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model amid increased scrutiny of AI lab protections. The release addresses concerns about safeguarding digital infrastructure.

cards.title: OpenAI Could Be IPO Ready in 2027
cards.body: OpenAI president Greg Brockman said the company could be ready for an IPO in 2027. The executive highlighted gains in the enterprise market against rival Anthropic.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Arrives in San Francisco
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is launching in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into the future of domestic automation. The service demonstrates practical AI applications beyond software, bringing robotics into everyday household tasks.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom Faces Political Uncertainty
cards.body: Texas has been the fastest-growing US data center market and epicenter of Big Tech's AI buildouts. Recent political shifts may jeopardize the state's position as the AI infrastructure hub.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Could Control Powerful AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach called "reverse game theory" aims to keep powerful AI models in check through strategic design. This method addresses growing concerns about controlling autonomous AI agents in enterprise environments.

cards.title: Data Lineage Security Critical for Agentic AI Systems
cards.body: AI agents pulling data from multiple sources risk propagating errors and security vulnerabilities across enterprise systems. Securing data lineage becomes essential as autonomous agents make decisions based on combined information sources.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Summoned by Congress Over Chinese Espionage
cards.body: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Congressional scrutiny regarding potential Chinese espionage concerns related to the company's AI hardware exports. The hearing reflects growing government attention to AI chip technology and national security.
